reason: Value lens: the base mismatch is real but it barely changes anything, and its decision value is ~0. (1) The dummy logs (_dl/biohub-exp58-x138-safe-lowref vs _dl/biohub-exp58t-x138-safe) show the -9%/+3.6% shift is almost all in the DeepCenter-REJECTED pool (149->135, 203->210). Post-veto candidates go 37/6/5/19 -> 37/6/5/20 and added safe forks 62 -> 63. My fork diff of the two dummy CSVs (tools/forkmid_dose.forks_of): 73 of 75 forks match (max midpoint shift 0.084 um); K2 gains 2 forks (1.09 and 4.58 um, both 6bba_05db0fb1) and loses 1 (5.22 um). So 1 of 5 forkmid-eligible forks is swapped. That matters for a zero-TP gate, but it is 1-2 forks per ~20 clips. (2) Ceiling from the metric (score = adj edge J + 0.1 div J; edges and forks among unannotated cells are free): forkmid removes ~3-7% of forks. Toy numbers TP 30 / FP 45 / FN 25: removing 3 FP moves div J 0.300 -> 0.309, which is +0.0009. Removing a wrong TP costs -0.0003, and the edge term is ~1e-5 per fork. So the base error in the rider's true value is <= ~+-0.0002, and the DC arc has similar or smaller exposure (a ~3% change in the rejected pool, less inside the 0.15-0.35 band). (3) The lab only decides whether a slot is spent. Adoption into F1 is still gated by an independent public check, R4 LB >= +0.002. For a rider whose true delta is in [-0.0005, +0.001], P(pass) is ~0.1. EV ~ P(flip 0.2) x P(LB pass 0.1) x 0.001 = ~2e-5, not the claimed 10-15% of worlds x 0.0005-0.001. (4) The lab is in-sample for the detector and edge net (pilkwang trained on all 199; the edge filter was +0.016 local but 0 on LB). That bias dominates the lowrefine-base correction by >10x, so fixing the base does not make the lab trustworthy. (5) The extra rule 't* identical on both bases' adds only a veto on a +0.0005-centre rider, and a t* flip mostly reflects noise from a SELECTION argmax over 28 clips. It is not transfer evidence. Not a closed line in disguise, but its gain is not measurable.

realistic_gain: ~0 on private (EV ~+2e-5); the zero-GPU check gives the same protection and saves ~4 GPU-h plus ~1 agent-hour at night
